posts.cooked:
Not counting 'next time' affects, like Haka of Battle, what's the largest amount of damage any hero can deal in one dealing of damage?

 

For instance:

Legacy: Inspiring Presence, Galvanize

Ra: Imbued Fire

Argent Adept: Two invocations of Syncopated Onslaught on Mr. Fixer

Parse: Two copies of Exploit Vulnerability

Mr. Fixer: Grease Monkey Fist, Dual Crowbars, and Harmony

Insula Primalis: Three copies of Obsidian Field

 

Mr. Fixer plays Charge to first hit a T-Rex for 15, then hits Zhu Long for 29. Now, Zhu Long only has 8 HP, so it's overkill, but the 29 is still dealt so counts.

 

Tachyon using Lightspeed Barage can easily beat this, of course.

 

Hmmm ... as I write this, I have the nagging feeling we've already done this thread ...
